cfg.section.dash.title: Live telemetry (dash)
cfg.dash.state_idle: idle (no dashboard is asking for telemetry)
cfg.dash.about: Every chatcli process can report what it is doing — agents, LLM requests and, as coverage grows, tools, skills, MCP servers, harness patterns and background work — as content-free events on a local bus. Off costs nothing. A process records only while a live dashboard holds the lease under the spool directory, or from boot when CHATCLI_DASH=1 (the switch for surfaces with no prompt: ACP, the MCP server, the gateway). Events carry names, sizes, durations and statuses, never prompt or tool content. Each process keeps at most about 16 MB of spool and dead processes are pruned after 24h.
help.command.dash: Live dashboard: a real-time graph of what every chatcli process is doing
complete.dash.open: Start the dashboard and open it in the browser
complete.dash.url: Start the dashboard and print its address only
complete.dash.status: Show whether telemetry is recording and which processes report
complete.dash.off: Stop the dashboard and let every process go quiet
dash.usage.title: Usage: /dash [open|url|status|off]
dash.usage.body: open (default) starts the live dashboard and opens the browser; url only prints the address; status shows who is recording; off stops it. Closing the browser tab also stops the recording, about 30s later.
dash.unavailable: Live telemetry is unavailable in this session (no home directory for the spool).
dash.serving_hint: read-only and local: the address carries a one-time token. Every chatcli process on this machine records while the page is open.
dash.not_running: The dashboard is not running. Start it with /dash.
dash.stopped: Dashboard stopped. Processes stop recording as the lease runs out.
dash.cli.hint: Every chatcli process on this machine records while the page is open. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
